component.name: LGL Power Profile Manager
component.summary: Manage tuned power profiles on Fedora and RHEL-based systems

description.p: LGL Power Profile Manager is a graphical interface for switching between tuned performance profiles without using the terminal.

It shows the active profile, lists every available profile with a human-friendly label and description, applies profiles through Polkit, and keeps a bounded command log. A reference page explains what each built-in profile is best for and when to avoid it.
If tuned is not installed, the application opens in setup mode with installation guidance instead of failing.
The maintained application has moved from Qt 6 to GTK 4.

ul.li: New GTK interface that follows the desktop theme, dark mode, accent colour, and user CSS
Application and system title-bar modes, with Ctrl+Shift+M
Keyboard-accessible main menu, standard shortcuts, and a system tray menu
Bundled Help window (F1) with a user guide for profiles, shortcuts, and the tray
Card-based profile list and reference pages with tested core parsing and settings logic
The application ID is now com.linuxgamerlife.lgl-powerprofile-manager; re-pin the application if it was pinned before
Prevent multiple instances of the application from launching simultaneously.
Window close button now minimizes to the system tray instead of quitting.
Right-click the tray icon to quit; left-click toggles the window.
System tray now shows the application icon.
